method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Rates.title: Five Charts That Show Rising Yields Reshaping Japanese Markets
Rates.reason: Direct, high-signal piece showing a broad rise in Japanese yields that is reshaping markets; strong evidence of bond-selloff / higher-for-longer dynamics in JGBs, material for global rates positioning.

Rates.title: Japan’s Two-Year Bond Yield Rises After Lukewarm Auction
Rates.reason: Concrete market-level move: 2-yr JGB yields moving higher after an auction signals renewed pressure at the short end and potential repricing of BOJ policy/taper expectations.

Rates.title: RBNZ’s Breman signals earlier and steeper rate hikes
Rates.summary: Reserve Bank of New Zealand (RBNZ) Governor Anna Breman said on Friday that the interest rates were likely to increase sooner and by more than previously signalled to combat inflation, Reuters reported.
Rates.reason: Central-bank guidance explicitly pointing to earlier/steeper hikes should push NZ rates up and feed global rate/hawkish sentiment; direct policy transmission to the rates market.

Rates.reason: Sticky core PCE at elevated levels is a high-signal macro datapoint that supports higher-for-longer Fed expectations and upward pressure on U.S. yields.

Rates.title: Core inflation in Tokyo stays below BOJ goal, factory output rebounds
Rates.reason: Tokyo core inflation below BOJ target is a disinflation signal that could reduce BOJ urgency to tighten and is supportive for JGB prices (counter to the prevailing rising-yield theme; included as a notable counter-signal).

Rates.title: Inflation-Wary Investors Pour Into Short-Dated Bond Funds
Rates.reason: Flow signal: investors shifting into short-duration funds reflects inflation/uncertainty and favors short-end demand while signalling caution for longer-duration bonds (net negative for long bond prices).
